# Setup 

## Load packages
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load packages, echo=F, warning=F, include=FALSE}
load_or_install_libraries <- function(x){
  for( i in x ){
    #  require returns TRUE invisibly if it was able to load package
    if( ! require( i , character.only = TRUE ) ){
      #  If package was not able to be loaded then re-install
      install.packages( i , dependencies = TRUE )
      #  Load package after installing
      require( i , character.only = TRUE )
    }
  }
}

#  Then try/install packages...
load_or_install_libraries( c("tidyverse" , "bigrquery" ,"devtools", "DBI","glue", "lubridate", "here", "sf", "extrafont", "patchwork", "terra", "rgeos", "ggspatial", "ggrepel", "tibble", "purrr", "stringr") )

# get fishwatch r independently 
if (!require("fishwatchr")) {devtools::install_github("GlobalFishingWatch/fishwatchr")}
library(fishwatchr)
```

## run voyage query
```{r voyages all, echo=F, warning=F, include=FALSE}

# create a temp table for query 
# voyage_table <- '`world-fishing-827.PortsProgramme.GAB_voyages_2023-25`'

# load query
voyages_q <- readr::read_file(here::here("queries", "GAB", "GAB_voyages_query_pipe5.sql"))

voyages <- fishwatchr::gfw_query(query = glue::glue(voyages_q, 
                                                    start_date = start_date,
                                                    end_date = end_date,
                                                    start_year = start_year,
                                                    end_year = end_year,
                                                    missing_ssvids = missing_ssvids,
                                                    # voyage_table = voyage_table,
                                                    port_iso = country_iso3,
                                                    prev_visit_search_date = prev_visit_search_date),
                                                    # manual_voyage_cte = manual_voyage_cte, # manual voyage 
                                 run_query = TRUE,
                                 con = con)$data

```

## add urls
```{r add gfw hyperlink for voyage, echo=F, warning=F, include=FALSE}

# base componenets for VV string to accompany port profiles 
base_string_p1 <- 'https://globalfishingwatch.org/map/vessel/'
base_string_p2 <- '?&start='
base_string_p3 <- '&end='
start_date_url <- '2025-01-01'
end_date_url <- '2025-3-31'

#format(voyages_with_coverage$trip_start, format='%Y-%m-%d')

# paste string components together using vessel id, trip start and trip end from data 
voyages_url <- bind_cols(voyages, 
                         vv_url = paste('=HYPERLINK("',
                          base_string_p1,
                          voyages$vessel_id, 
                          base_string_p2, 
                          as.Date(format(voyages$trip_start, format='%Y-%m-%d'))-2, 
                          base_string_p3, 
                          as.Date(format(voyages$trip_end, format='%Y-%m-%d'))+2,
                          '")', sep=''))

# write.csv(voyages_url, here::here("data","proactive", paste('GHA_Q2_test','-', Sys.Date(),".csv", sep='')), row.names=F)

```

## formatting
```{r format the data to TMT format, echo=F, warning=F, include=FALSE}
# change colnames to be sensible for an externally shared document 
voyages_reformat <- dplyr::select(voyages_url, vessel_name=shipname, mmsi=ssvid, vessel_id, callsign,
   vessel_flag=vessel_flag_best, imo, vessel_class_cat=vessel_class_initial, vessel_class_confidence = class_confidence_initial, vessel_class=vessel_class_best,
   vessel_type=geartype_best,  previous_port_country = start_port_iso3,
   previous_port = start_port_label, trip_start, trip_start_confidence, trip_end, trip_end_confidence, trip_duration_days,
   end_port = end_port_label, prev_visit_timestamp, at_dock, fishing=fishing, fishing_hours, fishing_eez=eezs, fishing_hs = high_seas, fishing_rfmos = rfmos, encounter= encounter, num_encounters, loitering=loitering, num_loitering, AISdisabling, num_AISdisabling, vv_url)
   #gaps=1, num_gaps, total_gap_hours)

# overwrite fishing_hs T/F
voyages_reformat$fishing_hs <- voyages_reformat$fishing_hs >0

# write out data for initial TMT QA - SKIP for second round corrections
write.csv(voyages_reformat, here::here("data", "GAB", paste(country,'_',start_year,'_',end_year,'_',Sys.Date(),".csv", sep='')), row.names=F)

```


```{r}
unique_vessels_GAB <- voyages_reformat %>%
  group_by(
    mmsi, 
    vessel_name, 
    vessel_flag, 
    callsign, 
    imo, 
    vessel_class, 
    vessel_type, 
    vessel_class_cat, 
    vessel_class_confidence
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    visits_in_timeperiod = n(),
    previous_countries   = paste(unique(na.omit(previous_port_country)), collapse = ", "),
    most_recent_visit    = max(trip_end, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_fishing_hrs    = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_encounters     = sum(num_encounters, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_loitering      = sum(num_loitering, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_AISdisabling   = sum(num_AISdisabling, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write.csv(unique_vessels_GAB, here::here("data", "GAB", paste(country,'_',start_year,'_',end_year,'_',Sys.Date(),"vessels",".csv", sep='')), row.names=F)

```
